about: The clocked-simulator trace (tests/_group_harness.py) of two plans, recorded on the engine as it stood BEFORE the S2 group driver (#189, task T10): the golden flow plan (groups == []) and three targets sharing a mosaic_group with no groups entry. Every mount, camera and guider call, every published sequence state and every sequence log line, each stamped with its fake time from the night's start. test_group_rotation.py holds the engine to it byte for byte. Never regenerate it to make that test pass: a difference is a non-group night that changed.
